howto: Pick Easy, Normal or Hard, then press Play.
Drag anywhere, or use the arrow keys, to move the paddle.
Tap or press Space to launch the ball, and keep it bouncing into the bricks.
Clear every brick to reach the next level. Lose every ball and the run ends.
tips: Where the ball hits the paddle sets its angle: the edges send it sideways.
Bricks with a white chevron take two hits (three on the top row from level 6).
Breaking bricks without touching the paddle builds a combo worth extra points.
A shield power-up saves one ball that would have been lost.
Catch Slow ball when things get hectic: the ball moves at 62% speed for 8 seconds.

controls.keyboard: Left and Right (or A and D) move the paddle, Space or Enter launches. P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Drag anywhere to move the paddle, tap to launch

difficulty: Easy, Normal and Hard on the title: Easy has a wider paddle, a 15% slower ball and 5 lives; Hard has a narrow paddle and a 15% faster ball. Every level adds a row of bricks and a little ball speed.

cheats.effect: Floor shield: the ball bounces off the bottom, so you never lose one
Big paddle: the wide paddle all the time
Multi-ball: every serve launches three balls

features.difficulty: Easy, Normal and Hard buttons on the title (remembered)
features.power-up-list: The title lists the four power-ups with their badges: 3x Multi-ball, W Wide paddle, S Slow ball, star Shield
features.wave-or-level-counter: LV in the top bar; LEVEL n pops up on every clear
features.high-score-table: Top 5 scores with level and difficulty on the Game Over card (runs with codes on are left out)
features.results: Game Over card with score, best, level, bricks, best combo, power-ups and the top-5 table
